en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large corner building housing the inn and guesthouse 'Einkehrgasthof Strasser'. The multi‑story structure has many shuttered windows, a pitched roof with several chimneys, and ground‑floor awnings with trees and a fenced garden terrace along the street. People can be seen near the entrance. Text identifying the business and address appears on the facade and in the lower right margin.
